name: devflow
description: An Issue-driven development loop for Claude Code and Codex: devflow follows approved Issue intent and validated local execution state, separates task checks from delivery acceptance, and guides review, integration and cleanup in repositories with a .devflow.json. Also ships four independent skills the loop does not call: decision-interview, write-prompts, audit-prompts and agent-instruction-design.

interface.longDescription: devflow resumes tracked work from approved Issue requirements and validated local execution state in repositories with a .devflow.json. One lifecycle skill covers discover, start, design, plan, build, verify, review, ship, cleanup and learn, loading the relevant procedure and selected delegation role as needed. Task checks, delivery acceptance, whole-Issue completion and cleanup each retain their own scope and evidence. Lifecycle hooks restore context and bound unattended continuation; session handoff remains explicit. Four independent skills ship alongside and work in any repository without the loop: decision-interview, write-prompts, audit-prompts and agent-instruction-design.
